doc_name: 关于进一步减轻义务教育阶段学生作业负担和校外培训负担的意见（中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发）
issuer: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅
quote_zh: 学科类培训机构一律不得上市融资，严禁资本化运作
quote_en: Academic tutoring institutions may not list or raise equity funds; capitalised operation is strictly forbidden.
notes: Named programme (双减). Other clauses: no new approvals, existing institutions registered as non-profit, online ones moved to approval system, foreign control banned, listed firms may not invest, prices under government guidance, existing institutions to be cut sharply (逐步大大压减). Supply-side elements present; capital/regulatory elements dominate by clause count (judgement).

doc_name: 关于进一步减轻义务教育阶段学生作业负担和校外培训负担的意见（中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发）
issuer: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅
quote_zh: 不再审批新的面向学龄前儿童的校外培训机构和面向普通高中学生的学科类校外培训机构
quote_en: No new approvals for after-school institutions aimed at pre-schoolers or for academic tutoring for senior-high students.

issuer: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅

quote_en: Do a good job of registering non-academic training institutions.
notes: Registration and supervision (fees, advertising, antitrust) - neutral regulated treatment.
